tbesh_subentries.definition_html:
outstretching, sending, sending forth
Another spelling of mish.lach (מִשְׁלַח "sending" H4916A)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: a sending out, i.e. (abstractly) presentation (favorable), or seizure (unfavorable); also (concretely) a place of dismissal, or a business to be discharged
strongs_1890.derivation: or מִשְׁלֹחַ; also מִשְׁלָח; from H7971 (שָׁלַח);
strongs_1890.kjv_def: to lay, to put, sending (forth), to set.
